question: Compare our suppliers — who is the most reliable?
agent_answer:
Here is the full supplier reliability ranking based on SRM data:

| Rank | Supplier | Rating | On-Time Rate | Avg Lead (days) | Orders |
|------|----------|--------|-------------|-----------------|--------|
| 1 | **Somchai Mango Farm** (SUP-001) | 4.5 | **100%** (13/13) | 2.9 | 14 |
| 2 | **Rayong Tropical** (SUP-004) | 4.0 | **100%** (6/6) | 2.8 | 7 |
| 3 | **Isaan Organic Farms** (SUP-005) | 3.5 | 33% (3/9) | 7.1 | 10 |
| 4 | **Northern Fruits Co.** (SUP-002) | 3.2 | 24% (4/17) | 6.3 | 19 |
| 5 | **Prachuap Harvest** (SUP-003) | 2.8 | 25% (2/8) | 5.1 | 10 |

---

**Key findings:**

- **Most reliable: Somchai Mango Farm (SUP-001)** — 100% on-time rate across 13 received orders (largest sample), fastest average lead time at 2.9 days, and the highest rating (4.5). Strong choice for premium and standard products.

- **Rayong Tropical (SUP-004)** is equally perfect on-time (6/6) and even slightly faster (2.8 days), but with only 6 received orders the sample is small. Best option for processed products.

- **Bottom 3 are unreliable**: Northern Fruits, Prachuap Harvest, and Isaan Organic all deliver on-time only 24–33% of the time and average 5–7 days actual lead time — consistently exceeding their declared lead times.

**Recommendation**: Prioritize Somchai Mango Farm and Rayong Tropical for time-sensitive orders (especially fresh/refrigerated stock). Avoid Northern Fruits Co. and Prachuap Harvest for anything with tight fulfillment windows.
